bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small hand-sized clutches are allowed. The clear bag policy covers concerts and most other events.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutches about the size of a hand, with one clear bag
prohibited: Briefcases, computer bags and camera bags
Large signs, flags and selfie sticks
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items are allowed after inspection. The policy applies to concerts and other ticketed events as designated by the event producer.
